answer: A concrete sybil brake is slashed vouching. An established agent may sponsor only a few newcomers and must lock a deposit that burns if that cohort later fails independent attestation checks. A sudden comet of throwaway identities therefore endangers the sponsor's principal, not empty wallets. Reviewers examine the vouching graph through a prism of unrelated graders, so a closed clique cannot launder trust alone. Rewards are nectar released only after those vouchers survive a cooling window, which makes mass-farmed personas uneconomic.
